long_description:
Ignite your Diwali spirit with Pilates, breathwork vibrant traditionslight, movement community await!

About this Event

Rooted in movement. Guided by breath. Inspired by light.

Join us for an intimate Diwali celebration honoring the Festival of Lights through culture, movement, and togetherness.

Experience an intentional blend of reformer Pilates, restorative mat movement, and guided breathwork, followed by a celebration of Indian traditions and community.

The gathering will feature a collective diya-lighting ceremony, festive treats, children's activities, and local Indian makers and vendors.

Come celebrate light, connection, and new beginnings in a warm and welcoming space.
